name: Esportsarr
description: Consolidates per-league esports channels (LCS/LEC/LCK/LPL, VCT Americas/EMEA/Pacific) into a fixed number of generic channels per game, switching the active stream to whichever live match currently holds priority.
author: 4rn0d

fields.label: Schedule JSON URL
fields.help_text: Raw URL to schedule.json published by the scraper's GitHub Actions workflow, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<user>/esportsarr/main/scraper/output/schedule.json

fields.label: Poll interval (seconds)
fields.help_text: How often the background scheduler applies the current stored plan to Dispatcharr and re-checks live reality (Twitch stream-title verification, cancelled/completed matches). Does NOT re-run allocation itself -- see 'Plan refresh interval' below.

fields.label: Plan refresh interval (hours)
fields.help_text: How often the full week-ahead schedule (which league/match plays on which channel, including Plat Chat/replay filler) gets recomputed from scratch. Every poll tick in between just applies that stored plan rather than re-deciding it, so the guide and the live stream can't drift apart from each other. 'Sync Now' always rebuilds immediately regardless of this setting.

fields.label: Channels per game
fields.help_text: How many generic channels (e.g. "LoL 1", "LoL 2", "LoL 3") to consolidate each game's leagues into. More slots means fewer matches get dropped/delayed when several leagues overlap. Must match what you ran 'Create Channels' with.

fields.label: Channel group name
fields.help_text: Dispatcharr channel group the generic channels are created under.

fields.label: League of Legends Priority
fields.help_text: Each tier below is a comma-separated list of league names, highest priority first. Tiers themselves rank International > Regional > Qualifiers, so it's rarely necessary to move a league between tiers, only to reorder within one. A league name must exactly match Riot's (run 'python -m esportsarr.list_leagues --game lol' in the scraper repo). 'Sync Now' will warn about leagues it saw live that aren't listed in any tier.

fields.label: LoL: International leagues
fields.help_text: Highest priority first. These always outrank every regional/qualifier league below.

fields.label: LoL: Regional leagues
fields.help_text: Highest priority first, ranks below all International leagues and above all Qualifiers.

fields.label: LoL: Qualifiers / secondary leagues
fields.help_text: Highest priority first, lowest tier overall. Leave blank if not applicable.

fields.label: Valorant Priority
fields.help_text: Same structure as the LoL priority above: International > Regional > Qualifiers, each tier a comma-separated list ranked highest-first within itself.

fields.label: Valorant: International leagues
fields.help_text: Highest priority first. These always outrank every regional/qualifier league below.

fields.label: Valorant: Regional leagues
fields.help_text: Highest priority first, ranks below all International leagues and above all Qualifiers.

fields.label: Valorant: Qualifiers / secondary leagues
fields.default: Last Chance Qualifier Americas,Last Chance Qualifier EMEA,Last Chance Qualifier Pacific,Game Changers NA,Game Changers EMEA,Game Changers Pacific
fields.help_text: Highest priority first, lowest tier overall. Must exactly match Riot's league name (run 'python -m esportsarr.list_leagues --game valorant' in the scraper repo), e.g. 'Game Changers NA', not 'Game Changers Americas'.

fields.label: Reservation lookahead (minutes)
fields.help_text: How far ahead a higher-priority match can preview/reserve a slot that's genuinely idle (nothing live wants it). Must be >= reservation_priority_minutes.

fields.label: Reservation priority window (minutes)
fields.help_text: How close to start a higher-priority match must be to actually compete for a slot that's about to free up. Wide enough to cover typical multi-hour gaps between back-to-back matches sharing a regional channel (e.g. VCT then Game Changers on the same Twitch channel). This never preempts a match already occupying a slot; a reserved/previewed slot keeps showing its last stream, it doesn't go blank.

fields.label: Guide lookahead (days)
fields.help_text: How many days ahead the guide shows real match data before falling back to "No Match Scheduled" filler. Overlapping matches across leagues are resolved the same way live sync is: the higher-priority one shows, the other is simply omitted for that window rather than queued.

fields.label: Twitch StreamProfile name
fields.help_text: Dispatcharr can't play a raw twitch.tv URL on its own. This must be the exact name of the streamlink-capable StreamProfile that makes it playable (Twitcharr installs one under this name; it only needs to have run once, it doesn't need to be tracking any specific league's channel). If Twitcharr renames its profile or you use a different one, update this to match.

fields.label: YouTube StreamProfile name
fields.help_text: For leagues that are YouTube-only (e.g. LPL). Dispatcharr can't play a raw youtube.com URL on its own either. The default here just tries the same profile as Twitch as an unverified guess, it has NOT been confirmed to actually work for YouTube. If it doesn't, set up a streamlink- or yt-dlp-capable StreamProfile yourself and point this at its exact name.

fields.label: Supplemental Content (idle-time filler)
fields.help_text: Fills a slot that's genuinely idle (nothing live wants it, nothing reserved) with Plat Chat VALORANT if it's actually airing, or an official match replay otherwise -- never competes with or bumps a real esports match. Requires yt-dlp installed alongside this plugin's own dependencies; see plugin/README.md.

fields.label: Enable supplemental content
fields.help_text: Off by default. Turn on once yt-dlp is confirmed installed in this Dispatcharr environment.

fields.label: LoL replay VOD channels (comma-separated YouTube URLs)
fields.help_text: Full-match VOD sources to pick a replay from when a LoL slot is idle. Riot's own official English full-match VOD channel by default.

fields.label: Valorant replay VOD channels (comma-separated YouTube URLs)
fields.help_text: VCT has no single central VOD channel like LoL does -- defaults to rotating across the three official regional channels (Pacific, Americas, EMEA).

actions.label: Create Channels
actions.description: Idempotently creates the channel group, the generic per-game channels, and the dedicated EPG source this plugin manages. Run this once before enabling the scheduler.

actions.label: Sync Now
actions.description: Rebuilds the full week-ahead plan immediately (ignoring the plan refresh interval) and applies it, without waiting for the next poll tick. Use this to verify behavior against a known live match before trusting the automatic scheduler.
